title: Elliptic maximum principle
problem: Let Ω be a bounded C² domain, c∈C(Ω̄) satisfy c(x)≥c₀>0, and u∈C²(Ω)∩C(Ω̄). If -Δu+c(x)u≥0 in Ω and u≥0 on ∂Ω, prove u≥0 in Ω̄.

offline_scenario.literature_notes: Fixture: standard weak maximum principle for a strictly positive zeroth-order coefficient; no external literature is fetched.
